capabilities: Style code blocks with built-in or custom color and syntax themes
Highlight lines, text ranges and occurrences via code fence parameters
Add headers with filenames, language icons and line numbers to code blocks
Fold, semi-fold and group code blocks into tabs
Render styled terminal prompts and comment annotations inside code blocks
extras: The PrismJS editor-mode syntax highlighting setting is explicitly labeled experimental; development is supported through a donation button, and further details are in a linked changelog.
problem: Obsidian renders code blocks with limited styling, and syntax highlighting differs between the editor (CodeMirror 6) and reading mode (PrismJS).

relations.evidence: The Plugin is compatible with Admonition and Execute Code plugins.
The Plugin is compatible with Admonition and Execute Code plugins.

summary: Code block styling plugin that adds themes, highlighting, headers, line numbers, folding, grouping and terminal prompts to code blocks.
